newsitem.title: USA: LSI Industries sees Q1 shr below estimates.
newsitem.headline: LSI Industries sees Q1 shr below estimates.

text.p: LSI Industries Inc said Friday it expects its first quarter earnings to fall below last year's first quarter results of $0.28 per share and below analysts' estimates.
In last year's first quarter, the company posted $2.19 million in net income, or $0.28 per share, on sales of $35.88 million.
Current analysts' estimates for the first quarter ended September 30 range from $0.31 to $0.34 per share, the company said.
LSI President and Chief Executive Robert Ready said the quarter started out on track.

"However, slower startup of image conversion programs by two major oil companies using our higher-margin printed products kept us from reaching our expected sales volume and profitability," he said in a statement.
Preliminary results for the period show sales of about $37 million, the company said.
It expects to report its results by October 30.
